summary: NextAvailability: responseId Not Validated Against availabilityId in NextAvailability (Mismatched Pair Accepted) (also: FLOW-V2-GALAVAIL-01-NEGHOP2)

impact: A caller that mixes ids from two searches silently gets a page from a search it did not intend, so wrong availability can be shown or selected; it also means the responseId is not an effective session guard.

impact: Session/offer binding is not enforced, so a caller can confirm an offer with ids of an unrelated search; mistakes in id handling are never reported back to the consumer.
evidence: **Round 2 status: still open, reproduced unchanged (first reported in Round 1, run 20261110-123507_Galileo-EGY-Availability-ne4).** FareConfirm prices the offer from selectedOfferId alone. A wrong selectedOfferId is rejected (HTTP 400), so only the ResponseId check is missing.

impact: Type validation is lax, so malformed clients are not told; low risk because the value is parsed correctly.
evidence: **Round 2 status: still open, reproduced unchanged (first reported in Round 1, run 20261110-123507_Galileo-EGY-Availability-ne4).** The first-page request accepts a passenger count sent as a JSON string ("2") and returns a normal availability page.
